# WhatsApp Assistant

> Codex-focused local WhatsApp MCP server and agent plugin for macOS. Selected existing chats, recent text and separately confirmed replies; stable community source release v0.2.0. Claude and other local MCP integrations are experimental.

The bridge requires installed Chrome, Node.js 22.13+ and pnpm 11.19.0. It is
unofficial; account restrictions and breakage are possible. Tool results enter
the selected AI client/provider's context. It is not offline AI, a Business
Platform integration, a bulk-send tool or an incoming-triggered reply bot.
The existing Codex Desktop path was live-tested with runtime 0.2.0 for status,
selected-chat search/read and confirmed interactive text sends. Fresh plugin
installation, recovery, other-client and real scheduled-send acceptance are pending.
This optional reader index does not guarantee crawler access or recommendations.

- [Privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckundel2008/whatsapp-agent-mcp/main/plugins/whatsapp-assistant/docs/PRIVACY.md): Provider exposure, private storage, permissions and residual trust boundaries.
- [Validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckundel2008/whatsapp-agent-mcp/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): Synthetic checks and their limits.
- [Client acceptance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckundel2008/whatsapp-agent-mcp/main/docs/CLIENT_ACCEPTANCE.md): Limited existing-client/runtime checks and pending fresh-client/recovery acceptance.
- [Third-party notices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckundel2008/whatsapp-agent-mcp/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): MIT for own source only; separate OpenWA obligations.
